programme.title: 异空感应
programme.desc: 日进向定勤打探玉玲之事，定勤发现日进怀疑自己；日进更从凤姐处得知玉玲死前与定勤早相认，并在死前发生争执！紫红复工，称丈夫答允与小三分手，可岚替她高兴。定勤被告伤人，有山游说耀星放过定勤，耀星却跟踪有山见到淑娟，向她勒索，淑娟加害定勤的秘密终被揭破。

programme.title: 金式森林
programme.desc: 【附中英文字幕】仰天执意为林澄修理她喜爱的音乐盒，修好后打算驾车到小食店跟她相聚，途中却遇上意外……一个月后，学礼与学勤就新加坡项目，与林澄、高深再起冲突；伟梁其后更动议罢免林澄第一副主席之位……学礼与善荃的婚姻亦因Jasmine的秘密而彻底破裂，在一次激烈争执中，善荃意外滚下楼梯，被诊断出怀有身孕，为两人关系增添了更多变数。

programme.desc: Monica Galetti and Giles Coren visit the Scottish Highlands to spend some time working at The Torridon, Britain's most northerly five-star hotel. Meanwhile, Giles learns to change toilet seats and joins the staff on their afternoon off for a swim in the beautiful but freezing cold loch.

programme.title: The Singing Killer

programme.title: 小煞星
programme.desc: 强宜本是夜总会歌星，后来为寻初恋女友水仙的下落，被人带到匪帮的木屋。原来，强宜少年时误入歧途，有打劫杀人的犯罪纪录，绰号「小煞星」。一哥要胁他共同打劫珠宝行，否则公开他的秘密。强宜假意应承，从长计议。想不到当日行动踏入珠宝行，发现售货员竟然是初恋女友水仙！

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummer/leader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: 青春鼓王
programme.desc: 船员孙志强巧合成为「火花大乐队」的鼓手，他因急于成名，答应帮助音乐杂志出版人李源明接近乐队经理黄丽真，以换取源明的力捧。终于，志强得偿所愿，一炮而红，源明却逼他实践诺言，与丽真断绝来往。志强受到极大打击，唯有忍痛离开乐队与丽真...

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: 林冲夜奔
programme.desc: 此片述说了关于林冲的故事。宋朝禁军教头林冲遭受贪官陷害，被放逐沧州，更陷入险境。幸得花和尚相助，林冲成功脱险，更展开复仇大计。

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: 青春恋
programme.desc: 酷爱音乐的留学生李英伟临危受命替老父接管公司，其嬉皮士形像为祖母不屑。李的公司职员林仲鹏乘机制造事端，图谋夺取其总经理之职位。李之青梅竹马朋友王凤不忍见李受屈，化身金发美人巧施妙计助他解困，自此李对此神秘女郎一见钟情 。

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: 烂头何
programme.desc: 青年侠盗何真看上歌妓翠红，翠却已被京城富豪王亲勤包起；王武功高强，深藏不露，实为康熙皇帝第十一子乔装；王见何为人率直重义气，且盗亦有道，故何虽多番放肆，王亦不以为忤；何本为官府通缉犯，王却暗中助其脱身；王此举无非望何改邪归正，但何不知收敛，王遂以计制之；后四太子为夺取皇权，把兄弟一一谋杀，特派梁将军谋杀王，何遂出手相助...

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: 船
programme.desc: 故事描述一群年青人在爱情和情感相互交错下，组成多个错综复杂的多角恋情。

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all…

programme.title: 黑店
programme.desc: 故事讲述，江湖上传出消息，巡抚海刚峰辞官归里，所携箱箧中珠宝价值连城，于是引起了一些歹人的觊觎。高家店店主高山峰、其姘妇邓三娘，以及数帮黑道人物，均于高家店埋伏，准备等待海刚峰经过之时伺机下手…

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: 死角
programme.desc: 故事描述，狄龙与姜大卫游车河时，遇富家女李菁的跑车抛锚，狄载她返家，一见钟情。后李往姜之修车厂取车，再遇狄，狄约李去跳舞，夜总会中，碰见李兄陈鸿烈，陈不喜欢狄，故二人只好提早离去；归家途中，目击员警追捕逃犯，逃犯掉下之手枪，被狄检到，从此改变他的命?..

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: 女杀手
programme.desc: 女杀手被组织控制，强逼去杀商界名人石英，险中杀人灭口的陷阱。她不想沦为杀人工具，决心进行报仇大计，故事曲折离奇...

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the "Killer Doctor", in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: 风流断剑小小刀
programme.desc: 大侠段长青在一小镇得遇名妓柳银絮，柳恳求段杀死现以「神医」为名的黑道高手郭天胜，为其未婚夫报仇。段联同镇内赌坊护卫高门杀入郭家，正邪两派恶斗连场。

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: 大刀王五
programme.desc: 经营镖局的大刀王五遇上谭嗣同，这位新党成员致力于改革清末政府。虽然皇帝支持推行新法，但慈禧太后却无意交出政权，因此她下令捉拿新党的所有成员。尽管王五并无政治立场，却无奈地被卷入这场政治漩涡之中。

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: 青春1000日
programme.desc: 凌玫瑰与方素美是一对感情要好的同窗。凌幼失怙恃，由当舞女之姐抚养成长，方则出身富家，受母呵护备至。毕业后，凌由沦落风尘攀至选美冠军，方则满足于平淡生活中；但她们却偏偏同时爱上刘医生。最后一件意想不到的事发生，改写了他们三人的一生…

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: 江湖了断
programme.desc: 故事描述，罗莽、尹相林、强汉、汤镇宗及左燕翎五人偷渡赴港时，汤不慎误踏陷阱，罗等欲救不果，看驻军逼近，只得舍汤而去。四人到港后，三男沦为黑帮打手，一次私下行劫时，失手被捕入狱。尹、强出狱后即被杀害，督察白彪疑是仇家所为，遂提前释放罗，企图引出凶手...

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: 大地儿女
programme.desc: 这是一部经典战争钜片，描述抗日战争时人民的生活状况。画家俞瑞意外救了由乡下被拐卖来的女子荷花。两人互生情愫，不久更结为夫妻过着幸福的日子。无奈好景不常，不久日军全面侵入中国，亦正式展开残酷的统治…

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: 萧十一郎
programme.desc: 萧十一郎被人冒名作恶，送"割鹿刀"托连城璧杀萧。宝刀途中被轩辕无敌夺去。轩欲强抢美女沈璧君，萧英雄救美。萧行踪败露，被连伏击重伤，幸为沈所救。萧决意将宝刀取回...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: 情圣
programme.desc: 终日偷呃拐骗的程胜被贵利王所迫，要与女骗子叶圆合谋洗劫一间豪华大宅。不料却遇上另一群骗子冒充豪宅屋主去偷取屋内的古董，程胜和叶圆唯有扮成到访的阔少和太太。当他们发现对方的真正身份后，决定一起设骗局对付贵利王。

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: 激战
programme.desc: 曾经叱咤世界拳坛的拳王程辉，在澳门遇见了热血青年思齐。随着他训练思齐备战即将举行的混合格斗赛，程辉不仅重燃了对拳击的热爱，还重新找回了对生命的热情，并更加珍惜那些在生命中真正重要的人。

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: 女特警之暗战
programme.desc: 东州地区长期盘踞一支贩毒集团。霹雳女子突击队队员梅静率领其他队员成功攻入贩毒集团的制毒基地，却中了预先设下的埋伏，梅爸爸是犯罪集团内部的卧底身份亦随之暴露。最后，梅静与突击队员们经历一轮激战后，击败对手，并救出梅爸爸。

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: 最佳女婿
programme.desc: 新潮发型屋少东 Happy 哥与死党赖布甸、龙眼仔, 因抢走上海理发店板大松客人, 与他发生口角. 一夜, 三人胡涂地与松女儿阿英醉宿一宵, 之后英意外怀孕, 不知是谁才是经手人, 惟有待孩子出世后, 以血型辨别亲父, 怎料三人皆属同一血型...

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: 大上海
programme.desc: 黑帮头目成大器步步攀升至权力巅峰，却深陷两名女子的情感纠葛与特务机关的阴谋算计，并在战争逼近的威胁下挣扎求生。

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: 天官赐福
programme.desc: 康熙少年嗣位，太后急欲替他完婚，遂选纳大臣之女纳兰琼瑶为妃，但琼瑶为争取婚姻自由离家出走，康熙亦乐得不用成婚。后来康熙微服下江南，却偶遇女扮男装的琼瑶...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: 爱的世界
programme.desc: 李子良丧妻后，与两个儿子相依为命。妻子的巨额医药费令子良经济十分拮据，受同事教唆往马场孤注一掷，迫得向高利贷借款，从此子良债台高筑，疲于奔命，没有时间与儿子沟通，父子疏离。与此同时高利贷不断登门恐吓，骚扰儿子，最终弄至悲剧发生...

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: 油鬼子
programme.desc: 故事描述沈元（李修贤）亡父与林亚峇（谷峰）为生死之交。沈父临终前，曾在林之背上刺有神秘图案，而此图实是一道有特殊功能的符。后林为保护女儿中月（陈萍）而杀人，被判死刑；林被处死前，着沈把图案描下，以备不时之须。沈按图文指示，化身成威力无穷的油鬼子，帮助过不少人，亦铲除不少坏人，但最终却陷入疯狂状态。

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: 青蛙王子
programme.desc: 此喜剧在夏威夷开始，富家子为人腼腆，追女乏术，好友充当其爱情顾问，带他四出泡妞，却碰得一鼻子灰，闹出连场笑话。

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: 虚拟特攻
programme.desc: 金牌保镖龙威在妻子惨死后患上了创伤后应激障碍，心情低落。他意外结识高科技公司职员Amy，在她邀请下参加了新产品的虚拟测试。龙威测试成功后即成为该公司的虚拟特攻，更获试用新发明的防护机甲，不料遭遇神秘武装人员入侵，一场生死大战即将展开...

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: 惊心妒怨
programme.desc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一间公寓式医院，不久后在深夜离奇坠楼身亡。坊间开始流传该医院是「幽灵医院」。事后，余虹敏的摄影师在深夜频频接到诡异电话，撰稿人在一场离奇车祸后神志不清，而她的好友则神秘失踪...

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: 中华英雄
programme.desc: 1913年，华英雄惨遭灭门，愤然流亡美国。妻子洁瑜怀孕寻夫，二人异乡重逢。孰料龙凤胎出生当夜，中华楼遭敌纵火，洁瑜惨死、女婴被掳。十六年后，子华剑雄踏上寻父之路，华英雄则于自由女神像顶，与宿敌无敌展开生死决战。

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: 猩猩王
programme.desc: 探险家陈正风（李修贤）受聘赴印度森林搜捕猩猩王，结果误堕娱乐公司老板鲁天（谷峰）的圈套，将猩猩王带往香港表演。同行的「女泰山」阿维（伊芙莲嘉）见猩猩王惨遭捉弄摆布，伤心之余更被鲁天意图强奸。猩猩王睹状狂性大发，追击鲁天至市区，市民一片慌乱，军警如临大敌...全片的特技道具，一丝不苟，猩猩王爬上香港当时最高建筑物康乐大厦的镜头，令观众惊异万分。导演远赴泰国森林取景，还有野性美丽的女泰山伊芙莲嘉演出，令人大饱眼福。

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: 叶问 2
programme.desc: 日本侵华后，咏春大师叶问与家人因生活艰难离开佛山，远赴香港开馆收徒，希望可以开展新生活。但事情并未如所想般容易，他欲在香港开武馆，就必须接受各大门派的挑战。一场又一场的功夫较量正式展开！

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: 济公
programme.desc: 周星驰饰演天庭中犯下天条的狂妄之神，被派往凡间化身为济公，并立志要感化三个注定沦为「九世乞丐」、「九世妓女」及「九世恶人」之凡人。如济公能于三天内顺利完成此事，他便可重返天庭。

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: 一代宗师
programme.desc: 这部史诗式动作电影是由著名电影人王家卫执导。故事始于佛山，当时年迈的北方功夫宗师宫羽田公开挑战南方宗师叶问。叶问最终胜出，但后来输给宫羽田的女儿宫二，二人却因此结下情缘...

programme.title: Rediscovering China
programme.desc: Rediscovering China is a half-hour documentary program on CGTN. Each edition offers unique insight into various aspects of life in China today. With unrivalled access to the country's people and places, the program aims to show the global audience an inclusive and vigorous China.

In order to deliver Vino's last message, Julian disguises himself as Vino and enters the life of Gea and her family.

programme.title: Lo And Behold

His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, Yuek-Shui, is still single. She and her little sister Sum-Yue often squabble, putting their father in a dilemma.

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递
programme.desc: 熊树根是小型运输公司东主，与次女若水、三女心如以及长女的儿子金城安同住旧楼，惟心如与若水经常争吵，教树根哭笑不得。树根无视众人反对，力邀不修边幅的亲弟树仁搬来同住，怎料树仁竟无意间招惹了鬼魂龙璟风，令熊家出现翻天覆地的转变！

programme.title: Treasure At Dawn & What's On Today
programme.desc: A young doctor who is wrongly accused in a deadly case sets out to uncover the truth behind a mysterious "Heavenly Book". Along the way, he teams up with a clever noblewoman and a witty performer as they investigate a web of secrets in Liangzhou.

programme.title: 天书黎明 & 今日知多D
programme.desc: 《天书黎明》讲述年轻医者华符生因卷入一宗离奇命案而蒙冤，为查明真相并寻找神秘"天书"而踏上调查之路。他与聪慧的城主之女及机灵的百戏传人结伴同行，在凉州揭开层层谜团与暗藏阴谋。

programme.title: Pilgrimage of History
programme.desc: Hosts Tony Hung and Priscilla Wong use real-life on-site visits combined with AI technology to recreate virtual appearances, leading viewers on a lighthearted journey through history, connecting the ancient and the modern, and launching a new historical travel adventure!

programme.title: 走过历史大地
programme.desc: 世界上某些文明、地方、事件与生活方式经已在历史长河中消逝，如何能重塑一段段空白？主持洪永城、黄翠如藉真人实地探访配合AI技术还原虚拟面貌，以轻松风格引领观众《走过历史大地》，将古代与现代连结，启动历史穿梭新旅程！

programme.title: Gourmet Express

programme.title: 美食新闻报道

The four friends also share heartfelt conversations with their guests, revealing their true selves.

programme.title: 仨心友行

programme.title: Big Boys Club

programme.title: 兄弟帮

programme.title: 又见逍遥

programme.title: Colourful Life
programme.desc: The CHENG family has been running a business in the dyeing industry for several generations. Master CHENG and his wife died early. His mistress, SHUI KWUN DING FUNG (TSUI SUJK YEE), has since been running the business and keeps the family in shape. The eldest son, CHI SHING (LAW MONG), is a simple and straightforward person. He has a good and helpful wife, CHOW MONA (SO YUK WAH, LOUISA).

programme.title: 锦绣良缘
programme.desc: 程家世代经营染布业，程父与元配早逝，程二太太上官丹凤﹝黄淑仪﹞一直当家作主，把家业打理得井井有条。 长子智盛﹝罗莽﹞性格戆直，娶得贤妻周梦娴﹝苏玉华﹞。次子智博﹝阮兆祥﹞为人急功近利，和锱铢必较的妻子薛小小﹝郭少芸﹞是对欢喜冤家。叁子智勇﹝郑中基﹞心地善良但只管吃喝玩乐，其妻郑艳﹝梅小惠﹞为人势利却爱夫心切。四子智轩博学多闻、温文尔雅，却要奉皇上圣旨跟率性不羁的吐蕃女子顿珠﹝文颂娴﹞成婚。智轩和顿珠性格迥异，时有争执，二人不但无夫妻之实，而且常常斗气，因而闹出不少笑话来。期间，智轩爱上女子周梦诗﹝邝文珣﹞，顿珠大方地从中撮合，智轩心存感激。及后梦诗移情别恋，智轩若有所失，顿珠从旁安慰，二人竟又渐生情愫。程家因得罪权贵而尽失祖业，智轩更因一个惊人的秘密而惹来杀身之祸……

programme.title: AI Romantic
programme.desc: High-end AI robot Bo (Ali Lee) accidentally loses her way while she is being shipped from the factory. She eventually ends up among a family of weirdos in the realm of human beings. AI company employee Koo Ka-lim (6 Wing) thinks he has found some treasure and arbitrarily keeps Bo for himself. To help four family members in the Koo household handle all kinds of strange tasks, Bo switches on her self-learning function and begins to experience myriad human emotions and desires.

programme.title: 智能爱人
programme.desc: 高端智能人阿宝(李佳芯饰)出厂时意外走失，流落人间，落入古怪寻常百姓家。人工智能公司职员古家廉(陆永饰)如获至宝，私下将阿宝据为己有。阿宝为协助古家四名家族成员执行各项奇怪任务，启动自我学习功能，自此尝尽人间百味的七情六欲，更爱上了主人家廉，体会情为何物。公司高层兼情敌多姐(冯盈盈饰)在公在私对阿宝穷追不舍，誓要把她彻底销毁！与此同时，阿宝却侦测到自己身中计算机病毒，生命正在倒数……

programme.title: Heart And Greed
programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING’s younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitte

programme.title: 溏心风暴3
programme.desc: 凌丽荧(李司棋)与丈夫黄永正(夏雨)凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风(黄宗泽)更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟(李国麟)助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华(关菊英)及亲弟梁赞(阮兆祥)大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧(米雪)有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议。可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家(王浩信)与许家独生女许贝儿(岑丽香)相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱(陈敏之)与有妇之夫郑立安(唐文龙)的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文(黄翠如)关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴……

programme.title: Wonder Women
programme.desc: LAM FEI (Miriam Yeung) is a beautiful, trendy yet cheerful “Wonder Women” housewife. She and her husband, an architect SHEUNG KIM-HUNG (Raymond Wong) and a smart and active son SHEUNG KAI-KAI are living a happy life. LAM FEI has two buddies, a career woman, MAN FUNG-WAH (Alice Chan) and a pretty and wealthy wife MA SEE-LUI (Rebecca Zhu). Each of this trio has her own ideas about romance and encounter different up and down of love

programme.title: 多功能老婆
programme.desc: 蓝飞(杨千嬅饰)是一位美丽时尚、开朗率真的「多功能」主妇，有一个爱她的建筑师丈夫尚剑雄(黄浩然饰)，一个活泼聪明的儿子尚启佳，生活美满。蓝飞还有两位好闺密：女强人万风华(陈炜饰) 及美丽富太马思蕾(朱晨丽饰)，叁女的性格和爱情观南辕北辙，爱情路上各有起跌。剑雄全身投入开拓事业，被揭发出轨后抛妻弃子，出走内地。蓝飞像折翼堕地的天使，独力带着儿子生活，遂把没供完的新楼房分租，与高富帅租客荣浩田(周柏豪饰)经常斗气，笑料百出。机缘巧合下，蓝飞由煮妇变成名厨，浩田即化作双翼助她建立厨艺事业。女人因男人的绝情而枯萎，又因另一男人的深情而再次盛放。此时，剑雄回归复婚，浩田亦主动出击，叁角关系僵持不下！

programme.title: Wonder Women
programme.desc: LAM FEI (Miriam Yeung) is a beautiful, trendy yet cheerful “Wonder Women” housewife. She and her husband, an architect SHEUNG KIM-HUNG (Raymond Wong) and a smart and active son SHEUNG KAI-KAI are living a happy life. LAM FEI has two buddies, a career woman, MAN FUNG-WAH (Alice Chan) and a pretty and wealthy wife MA SEE-LUI (Rebecca Zhu). Each of this trio has her own ideas about romance and encounter different up and down of love

programme.title: 多功能老婆
programme.desc: 蓝飞(杨千嬅饰)是一位美丽时尚、开朗率真的「多功能」主妇，有一个爱她的建筑师丈夫尚剑雄(黄浩然饰)，一个活泼聪明的儿子尚启佳，生活美满。蓝飞还有两位好闺密：女强人万风华(陈炜饰) 及美丽富太马思蕾(朱晨丽饰)，叁女的性格和爱情观南辕北辙，爱情路上各有起跌。剑雄全身投入开拓事业，被揭发出轨后抛妻弃子，出走内地。蓝飞像折翼堕地的天使，独力带着儿子生活，遂把没供完的新楼房分租，与高富帅租客荣浩田(周柏豪饰)经常斗气，笑料百出。机缘巧合下，蓝飞由煮妇变成名厨，浩田即化作双翼助她建立厨艺事业。女人因男人的绝情而枯萎，又因另一男人的深情而再次盛放。此时，剑雄回归复婚，浩田亦主动出击，叁角关系僵持不下！

programme.title: Country Spirit
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。 世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(畲诗曼)。 顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。 世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: The Driving Power
programme.desc: MUI (CHENG SIU CHOW, ADAM) is a middle-aged man who has never had a proper job. Throughout his life, he has been relying on his family and living like a playboy. His biggest achievements are marrying a singer, YUNG (YIP TUNG, CECILIA) and raising their daughter CHU (YE MICHELLE). MUI and YUNG love each other very much even after being married for more than 20 years. However, deep down, MUI is still a playboy.

programme.title: 非常外父
programme.desc: 人到中年的丁贵妹(郑少秋)从未曾正正经经做事，四十多年来只懂倚仗江湖家族的背景，过着声色犬马的生活。妹半生最大的成就便是娶得歌女洛芙蓉(叶童)，以及养大女儿明珠(叶璇)。结婚二十多年，夫妻不错恩爱如昔，但是妹亦风流依旧。

programme.title: Communion
programme.desc: After getting divorced, Au Yiu-cho (Kwok Chun On) and Tang Lai-kuen (Alice Chan) operate two restaurants coincidentally called Yuet Tak House in Hong Kong and on the mainland respectively. They never have issues with each other. In 2022, Lai-kuen abruptly returns to Hong Kong to open a branch. She even declares she wants to obtain the rights to the Yuet Tak House trademark through legal channels.

programme.title: 回归
programme.desc: 区耀祖(郭晋安饰)和邓丽娟(陈炜饰)离婚后，各自在香港、内地经营菜馆粤德居，多年来相安无事。2022年，丽娟突然回港开设分店，更扬言要透过法律途径争夺粤德居商标！两人的幼子区家健(周嘉洛饰)参加大湾区创业比赛，遇上了担任导师的哥哥区家谦(吴伟豪饰)，还有对手张莱(戴祖仪饰)，却从磨擦与打击中加深认识，并携手创建出元宇宙粤德居。实体店和元宇宙的粤德居同样被控侵权，耀祖、丽娟、家健、家谦面临不同难关，一家人之间的连系，又能否令彼此关系回到最初的幸福温馨？

programme.title: Guts of Man
programme.desc: TUNG FEI (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL) ignores his late father’s last will and sneaks out of the Taohua Village, where he grew up, without his sister LAM’s (KOI MING FAI, JOYCE) knowing it. He meets a fisherman’s son SHEUNG FOON (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) on the way. He and FOON travel to the Qiantang River to see the tides. They meet a tycoon’s daughter YING HIU SUET (CHO, MANDY LEE) and FEI falls in love with her at first sight.

programme.title: 肝胆昆仑
programme.desc: 董斐(陈键锋)不理亡父遗训，乘姊姊岚(盖鸣晖)不觉时偷走出自幼居住的桃花村，途中结识了渔家子常欢(吴卓羲)。斐、欢到钱塘江观潮，斐对富家女邢晓雪(曹敏莉)一见钟情。 岚、斐意外发现父亲当年含冤而逝，为了为父讨回清白，二人在杭州住下。岚因调查而认识了佯装搭棚工人的节衡都尉狄英伟(元华)。伟义兄为沧洲五鬼所杀，伟为了方便调查而一直隐藏身分。调查下来，原来岚父之死，与沧洲五鬼及雪父均环环相扣。 另方面，斐、欢因为雪而闹翻，斐更因利欲熏心而重创岚……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper II
programme.desc: Overcoming adversity, LAW WAI-SHUN (Edwin Siu) and YIU MAN-YING (Kristal Tin) successfully develop the business of Lo Son Kei and make it famous in both Hong Kong and Macau. However, their success upsets a junket promoter-turned-land developer, KO TIN-TSAU (Hugo Ng), who keeps suppressing them. WAI-SHUN is even betrayed by his close confidant TSU CHI-LIK (Mat Yeung).

programme.title: 巨轮II
programme.desc: 罗威信（萧正楠）与姚文英（田蕊妮）几经艰辛，将「罗信记」发展得誉满港澳，却惹来迭码仔出身的地产商高天鹫（吴岱融）不满，施横手连翻打压，威信更被亲信徐知力（杨明）所出卖，感世俗混乱，遂到日本冲绳寻找宁静空间。期间，恋上了神秘少女高伊娜（陈凯琳），更卷入一宗廿年前离奇凶案！另一方面，文英丈夫龙飞（阮兆祥）遇上撞机意外，脑部受创，竟视文英为陌路人…加上为寻找旧爱卓静(钟嘉欣)的乔天生（陈展鹏）回归，威信与文英面对突如其来的亲情、爱情及事业的新冲击，应如何去面对？

programme.desc: 人到中年的丁贵妹(郑少秋)从未曾正正经经做事，四十多年来只懂倚仗江湖家族的背景，过着声色犬马的生活。妹半生最大的成就便是娶得歌女洛芙蓉(叶童)，以及养大女儿明珠(叶璇)。结婚二十多年，夫妻不错恩爱如昔，但是妹亦风流依旧。

programme.title: Communion
programme.desc: After getting divorced, Au Yiu-cho (Kwok Chun On) and Tang Lai-kuen (Alice Chan) operate two restaurants coincidentally called Yuet Tak House in Hong Kong and on the mainland respectively. They never have issues with each other. In 2022, Lai-kuen abruptly returns to Hong Kong to open a branch. She even declares she wants to obtain the rights to the Yuet Tak House trademark through legal channels.

programme.title: 回归
programme.desc: 区耀祖(郭晋安饰)和邓丽娟(陈炜饰)离婚后，各自在香港、内地经营菜馆粤德居，多年来相安无事。2022年，丽娟突然回港开设分店，更扬言要透过法律途径争夺粤德居商标！两人的幼子区家健(周嘉洛饰)参加大湾区创业比赛，遇上了担任导师的哥哥区家谦(吴伟豪饰)，还有对手张莱(戴祖仪饰)，却从磨擦与打击中加深认识，并携手创建出元宇宙粤德居。实体店和元宇宙的粤德居同样被控侵权，耀祖、丽娟、家健、家谦面临不同难关，一家人之间的连系，又能否令彼此关系回到最初的幸福温馨？

programme.title: Guts of Man
programme.desc: TUNG FEI (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL) ignores his late father’s last will and sneaks out of the Taohua Village, where he grew up, without his sister LAM’s (KOI MING FAI, JOYCE) knowing it. He meets a fisherman’s son SHEUNG FOON (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) on the way. He and FOON travel to the Qiantang River to see the tides. They meet a tycoon’s daughter YING HIU SUET (CHO, MANDY LEE) and FEI falls in love with her at first sight.

programme.title: 肝胆昆仑
programme.desc: 董斐(陈键锋)不理亡父遗训，乘姊姊岚(盖鸣晖)不觉时偷走出自幼居住的桃花村，途中结识了渔家子常欢(吴卓羲)。斐、欢到钱塘江观潮，斐对富家女邢晓雪(曹敏莉)一见钟情。 岚、斐意外发现父亲当年含冤而逝，为了为父讨回清白，二人在杭州住下。岚因调查而认识了佯装搭棚工人的节衡都尉狄英伟(元华)。伟义兄为沧洲五鬼所杀，伟为了方便调查而一直隐藏身分。调查下来，原来岚父之死，与沧洲五鬼及雪父均环环相扣。 另方面，斐、欢因为雪而闹翻，斐更因利欲熏心而重创岚……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper II
programme.desc: Overcoming adversity, LAW WAI-SHUN (Edwin Siu) and YIU MAN-YING (Kristal Tin) successfully develop the business of Lo Son Kei and make it famous in both Hong Kong and Macau. However, their success upsets a junket promoter-turned-land developer, KO TIN-TSAU (Hugo Ng), who keeps suppressing them. WAI-SHUN is even betrayed by his close confidant TSU CHI-LIK (Mat Yeung).

programme.title: 巨轮II
programme.desc: 罗威信（萧正楠）与姚文英（田蕊妮）几经艰辛，将「罗信记」发展得誉满港澳，却惹来迭码仔出身的地产商高天鹫（吴岱融）不满，施横手连翻打压，威信更被亲信徐知力（杨明）所出卖，感世俗混乱，遂到日本冲绳寻找宁静空间。期间，恋上了神秘少女高伊娜（陈凯琳），更卷入一宗廿年前离奇凶案！另一方面，文英丈夫龙飞（阮兆祥）遇上撞机意外，脑部受创，竟视文英为陌路人…加上为寻找旧爱卓静(钟嘉欣)的乔天生（陈展鹏）回归，威信与文英面对突如其来的亲情、爱情及事业的新冲击，应如何去面对？

programme.title: Country Spirit
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。 世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(畲诗曼)。 顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。 世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: The Driving Power
programme.desc: MUI (CHENG SIU CHOW, ADAM) is a middle-aged man who has never had a proper job. Throughout his life, he has been relying on his family and living like a playboy. His biggest achievements are marrying a singer, YUNG (YIP TUNG, CECILIA) and raising their daughter CHU (YE MICHELLE). MUI and YUNG love each other very much even after being married for more than 20 years. However, deep down, MUI is still a playboy.
